{{Vanilla|Jungle Pyramid}}
A '''jungle pyramid''' generates as in vanilla. [[Matcha Flavoured]] changes its chest loot and the arrows in its dispensers. The [[Archaeologist]] sells Jungle Temple Maps at level 2.
